items.title: EXT-005 claim probe: does the SD-031 comparator residual discriminate externally-caused from self-caused world change (MOVE_OK stratum)
items.note: EXT-005 claim probe (EXP-0527 / EVB-1250, proposal_type=experimental -- matched on the (backlog_id, proposal_type) key; EVB-1250 also carries a literature_review twin LIT-0530 which is deliberately NOT touched). Asks whether SD-031's single-pass comparator residual = z_world_obs - E2WorldForward(z_world_prev, a_actual) actually discriminates externally-caused from self-caused world change, i.e. whether REE has the causal-signature mechanism EXT-005 says LLMs lack. GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): decisive readout is auroc_move_ok. Searched all evidence/experiments manifests -- only v3_exq_177 and v3_exq_783 carry an attribution readout at all, and 783 (the only run reaching attribution_ready=True) recorded attribution_gap NULL on all 16 of its D128 arms with 'insufficient events of one or both causal classes'. The readout has therefore NEVER been obtained; not recoverable -> run. This driver's contribution is to manufacture causal-class balance by construction (env_drift_interval=2, env_drift_prob=1.0, random policy incl. the STAY action), which is also why it does not inherit 783's ARC-065 behavioural-diversity dependency. SUBSTRATE READINESS (2.5/2.5a): measurement-only, so untouched by the commitment/conversion ceiling -- the agent is constructed but NEVER driven (no sense/select_action, no E3); only split_encoder and a standalone E2WorldForward run. Probed live: world_dim=128 -> attribution_ready True (dim-32 hard-assert verified to refuse), action pathway wired (0.263 at init), SD-070 P0a moves 4/4 world_encoder tensors (holdout_mean_lift 0.58). The 2026-06-06 dim-32 ceiling is REFUTED by its own prescribed retest (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-783: under-differentiation is a TRAINING fault, SD-070 fixes it). RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): 0 counting autopsies on EXT-005, 0 on SD-031 -- does not fire. 2.5c: no exercised open CORRUPTING defect -- mode-governance-engagement and SD-082 gates verified OFF live on this exact config (salience_affinity_input_cap None, use_lateral_pfc_analog False); e1_deep.py defects unreachable (agent never driven). Open DEGRADING overlaps recorded in the manifest: SD-018 (both resource heads absent here), mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING. DESIGN: verdict read from the MOVE_OK stratum ONLY. Measured at authoring, the STAY and MOVE_BLOCKED strata are DEGENERATE -- the agent does not displace so a hazard is the only possible source of change and bare ||z_obs-z_prev|| already gives AUROC 0.996 / 1.000; a criterion read there is an arithmetic identity. In MOVE_OK the agent's own displacement dominates and the raw signal sits at chance (0.453), so discrimination must come from action-conditioned prediction. Those two strata are retained as recorded POSITIVE CONTROLS. C1 (load-bearing) mean(auroc_move_ok)-0.5 >= max(0.05, 1sd); C2 (load-bearing) mean(auroc_move_ok - auroc_bare_move_ok) >= max(0.05, 1sd) -- the EXT-005-critical one, fail it and the signature is a change detector; C3 (supporting) vs an action-permutation control >= 0.02. Noise-aware (abs floor AND one cross-seed SD) deliberately, per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-783 sec 3 on a label decided by a 0.0028 margin. PASS = C1 AND C2. Verified jointly satisfiable across the whole admissible bare-AUROC band; neither vacuous (C1 binds for bare<=0.50, C2 above). Thresholds calibrated on a single-seed authoring pilot (seed 42) which is EXCLUDED from SEEDS=[43,45,46,47,48], so every scored seed is out-of-sample; seed 44 skipped per EXQ-539/540 instability. Five gating readiness preconditions, all self-routing below-floor to substrate_not_ready_requeue (never a claim verdict). DV-SYMMETRY (single arm, BASE): DV is a within-stratum AUROC of the residual norm; its symmetry group is monotone rescalings and within-label-class permutations. The manipulation (training E2WorldForward) is NOT invariant -- it re-ranks steps ACROSS the label boundary (confirmed: bare 0.4532 -> 0.5942), so it is neither a broadcast constant, nor a monotone rescaling, nor a within-class permutation. red-team (fable), ONE pass: CONTESTED -> all 3 findings FIXED, none dismissed. (1) the wiring precondition was measured AFTER training, so a head that LEARNS action-irrelevance -- which IS the causal_signature_absent_change_detector_only finding -- would have misrouted to substrate_not_ready_requeue, byte-identical to dead wiring; now gates on the AT-INIT probe with the trained value kept as a diagnostic. (2) overall=C1 and C2 never consulted C3, so C1+C2 passing with the action-permutation control FAILING would have recorded an unqualified 'causal_signature_present'/supports; now yields the qualified label ..._action_conditioning_unconfirmed. (3) EXT-005's registered subject is llm.causal_attribution, which no V3 run can observe, so a bare supports/weakens is unattributable between the LLM assertion and the REE remedy annotation; now records a claim_scope block with an explicit attribution_caveat scoping the direction to the remedy (V3-EXQ-991 attribution_caveat precedent). A 4th MINOR finding (substrate_not_ready_requeue names no automated requeue) DISMISSED with citation -- that label is the skill-mandated self-route and requeue is a governance action, not automation; recorded as requeue_semantics so it does not read as a broken promise. Reviewer separately verified clean: manipulation reaches the DV, the comparator zero-sentinel is unreachable at dim 128, and the periodic drift label does not leak into z_world via body_state[9] (z_world is encoded from world_obs only, stack.py:965). SD-013 ARM REMOVED ON DESIGN-TIME PROOF (found by post-red-team verification, not by the reviewer): an INTERV arm adding compute_interventional_loss was built, then removed as STRUCTURALLY INERT -- the hinge max(0, margin - ||f(z,a)-f(z,a_cf)||) has margin 0.1 while action-divergence is ALREADY ~0.234 at init and rises to ~2.2 by epoch 40, so it is slack from the first step and supplies zero gradient (measured engagement 0/60 batches every seed; arms came out BIT-IDENTICAL on every metric). Two traps recorded in the docstring: a nonzero interventional LOSS is not evidence of engagement (a uniformly-drawn a_cf can COINCIDE with a_actual, giving l2_dist 0 -> loss==margin with zero gradient, violating compute_interventional_loss's own 'must differ' contract at e2_world.py:341), and the pilot's apparent BASE/INTERV divergence was RNG-consumption drift, an artifact. The margin was deliberately NOT raised to force engagement. Verdict-bearing science is untouched. Follow-on: a genuine SD-013 test needs a margin calibrated to z_world's operating scale at world_dim=128. Cross-machine-class safe: no torch.multinomial and no committed-action assertions; all DVs are rank statistics over deterministic forward passes. Smoke PASS (dry-run green; the causal_class_events precondition correctly fails at toy scale and self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue). validate_experiments --strict OK; validate_recording --strict complete.
